## How to play

**Before the pull:** **Blade Flurry**.

**Keep up all fight:** **Slice and Dice**.

**Then press the first one that is ready**, top to bottom:

1. **Garrote**: keep it on the target (timing: see below)
2. **Vanish** when Garrote is not on the target (timing: see below); no global cooldown, so press it alongside the others
3. **Shank** (timing: see below)
4. **Eviscerate** (timing: see below)
5. **Backstab**

**Backstab** is your filler: cast it whenever nothing above is ready.

*The simulator's full rotation for this build, with every condition: [research rotation page](../research/raid/rotation.md).*

## Why this rotation

Combat in a raid is a dagger rotation run on energy: **Backstab** from behind builds combo points, **Slice and Dice** stays up, and 4 or more points go into **Eviscerate**. **Shank** goes on cooldown for energy and for **Venom**, **Blade Flurry** before the pull and again when it is back. The build's 21 Assassination points make your poisons about a sixth of your damage (796 DPS in a full raid).

**Why it works**

- **Slice and Dice** comes first: 30% more attack speed, and white hits (with Windfury Totem's extra swings) are about 45% of this build's damage in a full raid. Put it back up the moment it drops, even with 1 combo point: it lasts 9 seconds at 1 point and 21 at 5, and **Improved Slice and Dice** makes that 45% longer. The list never refreshes it early: while it is up, your points go into **Eviscerate**.
- **Eviscerate** goes at 4 or more points, and at 3 when **Slice and Dice** has 6 seconds or less left: about 16 a fight and 13% of the damage. Waiting for 5 wastes points: **Puncturing Wounds** gives **Backstab** a 45% chance to add a second point, and **Ruthlessness** adds a point after 60% of your finishers. **Flawless Execution** cuts its cost from 35 to 20 energy, and **Coup de Grace** and **Aggression** add 20% and 10% to its damage.
- **Shank** costs 5 energy and gives back 25; **Flash of Steel** adds 15 more and takes its cooldown from 10 to 8 seconds. Press it whenever it is ready and you have 80 energy or less: about 23 times in a 3-minute fight. Each one also starts **Venom**: 30% more poison damage and a 20% better chance to apply poisons for 6 seconds, so it is up most of the fight.
- Your poisons deal about 17% of the damage: **Vile Poisons** adds 12% to them, **Improved Poisons** applies them more often and sometimes without spending a charge, **Malice** adds 5% crit to them and to your attacks. **Blade Flurry** (20% more attack speed for 15 seconds, 2-minute cooldown) goes 3 seconds before the pull and again when it comes back: twice in a 3-minute fight.
- **Backstab** is your only builder and your filler: 60 energy, from behind, with a dagger in your main hand; about 37 a fight and 22% of your damage. **Lethality** adds 20% to its crit damage, **Puncturing Wounds** 30% to its crit chance, and **Hack and Slash** gives you crit with daggers.

**Caveats**

- **Backstab** needs a dagger in your main hand and you behind the target. If you cannot get behind the boss, build with **Sinister Strike**; with a sword, take the swords setup this page links (21/30/0), which plays that way.
- **Garrote** is on the list, but it only works from stealth: the simulator presses **Vanish** a second into the fight and opens a **Garrote** right after, once a fight (**Vanish** has a 5-minute cooldown). Starting the fight in **Stealth** was not simulated.
- While **Blade Flurry** is up, your attacks also strike a second nearby target: with adds, it is your cleave.

**When to change it**

- In the last 6 seconds, skip **Slice and Dice** and put any combo points, even 1, into **Eviscerate**: a buff that outlives the boss does nothing.
- If no warrior keeps Sunder Armor on the target (a small group or a dungeon), keep **Expose Armor** up at 5 points. The simulator's list has a switch for it, off in a raid; an earlier search on the training dummy, where nothing else lowers armor, measured about 10% from it.
